about_the_game:
The Aztecs - a Mesoamerican culture that flourished for three great centuries, dominating vast stretches of land in the area and creating a society unique in world history. A gifted and wise nation, rich in complex traditions and beliefs. Become an Aztec leader and do everything you can to make history remember your people.



Aztecs: The Last Sun is a city builder set between the 13th and 16th centuries CE. As your nation’s great leader, you are responsible for building and bringing to splendor the magnificent city-state of Tenochtitlan. This amazing architectural wonder was historically located on an island in the middle of Lake Texcoco and therefore presents the technological and economic challenge of providing food for your people and maintain a permanent trade route with the outside world.



Aztecs: The Last Sun perfectly combines three different aspects of city management: Take care of economic, military and religious growth and prosperity in your city-state. Invest in culture and erect monumental buildings, build up a mighty army and make human sacrifices to the Gods. They will surely repay you when hard times come.

short_description: Aztecs: The Last Sun is a city builder and management game. Become the ruler of the great city-state of Tenochtitlan. Develop a city, build an army, gain the favor of Gods. Will your empire rise to glory, or be lost to history? The choice is yours!
